newsitem.title: PERU: Japan's Ikeda to meet Peru's Fujimori over crisis.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Ikeda to meet Peru's Fujimori over crisis.

text.p: Japanese Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda was set to meet Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori on Saturday night in an effort to find a breakthrough to the four-day-old hostage crisis.

Japanese officials travelling with Ikeda said the two men would meet in Government Palace at 11 p.m. EST (0400 GMT on Sunday). It would be their second meeting since Ikeda arrived on Thursday to help negotiate a peaceful solution.

Fujimori has kept a public silence since Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima late on Tuesday. The rebels were still holding about 340 hostages late on Saturday.
Ikeda was sent by Tokyo to persuade Fujimori, better known for his strong-arm tactics than diplomacy, to adopt a non- violent strategy for the crisis.
Peruvian and Japanese officials could not say what was on the agenda for the meeting.
